usedFor: Zenventory tracks stock, Google Docs holds the log, and “New Purchase Order” feeds “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Purchase Order” in Zenventory, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each purchase order adds its text to the log, so the doc tracks what is on order.

watchOut: “New Purchase Order” in Zenventory is polling, so the doc updates after a scheduled check.
